values.wording:
The Proposed Ordinance amends Chapter 133.01 "Established; Power and Duties" of the Codified Ordinances of the Village of Perry regarding the duties of the Village Fiscal Officer before signing Village agreements with a hyperscale data center involving tax abatements, PILOT Programs, or any special tax designation.

Shall the proposed ordinance amending Chapter 133.01 "Established; Power and Duties" of the Codified Ordinances of the Village of Perry be adopted?
values.description: Duties of Village Fiscal Officer before signing Village agreements with a hyperscale data center involving tax abatements, PILOT Programs or any special tax designation
values.passage_rule: A majority affirmative vote is necessary for passage.
values.scope: Official master sample ballot physical page326; printed page2 of2 for Perry Village AA. Full ordinance, hyperscale definition, exact guarantee/noise provisions and policy polarity unresolved; no 25 MW threshold imported.
